cohort: 361 premature neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) at Shambu General Hospital between January 2018 and March 2021
finding: Several factors were significantly associated with the death time of premature neonates, including gestational age, neonatal sex, maternal hemoglobin level, and birth weight.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with the death time of premature neonates.
